files.description: eDerm proprietary REST API documentation (26 pages). Covers OAuth authentication, patient search, encounter listing, and patient data retrieval (C-CDA export). Documents the (g)(9)/(g)(10) API, NOT the (b)(10) EHI export. This is the only technical documentation available from the vendor.

FHIR Endpoint Bundle containing two Organization/Endpoint pairs registering the FHIR service base URL (https://fhir.ederm.io:9443/fhir-server/api/v4/). This is a (g)(10) service registration artifact, not EHI export documentation.

eDerm ONC certification / mandatory disclosures page. Contains Drummond Group letter, links to API documentation and ValidURLs.json, and links to Real World Testing plans/results. No EHI export or (b)(10) documentation is present on this page.

Full-page screenshot of the eDerm ONC certification page, showing the complete layout including the Drummond Group letter, documentation links, and Real World Testing links. No EHI export section visible.
Screenshot of browser error when navigating to the registered FHIR metadata URL. Shows ERR_CERT_DATE_INVALID due to expired Let's Encrypt SSL certificate (expired Feb 10, 2026).
